* Generic base classe for Diffie-Hellman style key agreement backed by the OpenSSL engine.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: mPrivateKey
variables.comment: OpenSSL handle of the private key. Only available after the engine has been initialized.

variables.name: mExpectedResultLength
variables.comment:
* Expected length (in bytes) of the agreed key ({@link #mResult}). Only available after the
     * engine has been initialized.

variables.name: mResult
variables.comment: Agreed key. Only available after {@link #engineDoPhase(Key, boolean)} completes.
